identity_policy.acceptance: Accepted battle, adventure and portrait assets require checksum-bound native-size identity review under assets/reviews.
identity_policy.rule: Independent Bandle identities: two walking-melee lines, one flying animated-paper line, one grounded animated-instrument support line, two finite physical ranged lines and one grounded living mirror ranged/caster line. Precision and Clone each cost an action and one native battle charge; no troop Teleport or tier-seven flight. No original or other Runeterra troop recolors; no mass-produced champions.

original_resource_references: Structure and rendering language only: original Heroes III creature, town and siege layouts measured for scale.
release_policy: Every required output needs an approved source, a recorded checksum, redistribution rights and native-size visual acceptance. No placeholders.
visual_direction: Original Heroes III Castle/Rampart painted 2D compatibility; rooted yordle homes, mossy terraces, warm windows, muted teal and violet, folded parchment fae, walking brass telescopes and living female yordle mirror artisans. Larger foreground buildings; seven dwellings upgrade in place.
